name: conversation.utterance
description: One thing said, as it was said. The record a question matches on. It names the entities it is about through links rather than repeating them, and carries who said it and when.

attributed.description: True when an AI assistant ORIGINATED this claim rather than a person — world knowledge it supplied, or something it produced on request. It means the graph records that this was said, not that it is so. Absent on a person's claim, which is the overwhelming majority, and absent on an assistant turn that merely hands back the user's own fact (that claim is the user's). DECLARED rather than left undeclared so a filter on it is a native index pre-filter instead of an exhaustive scan.
